title: CHANGELOG 0.14.0: say that lore sync re-files log entries for commits that also touched docs/log.md
description: LCLI-711 (DEC-172 (4bq), e21c4691, shipped in v0.14.0) made foldersTouched in src/core/log.ts exclude the bundle own generated log.md. A commit that touched docs/log.md plus docs/adr/x.md used to file under the shared parent docs; it now files under its other paths deepest common folder. The entry SET is unchanged, only the section moves. The CHANGELOG line for LCLI-711 says a mixed commit is still logged by its other paths but never says the section changes, so opum-desktop saw 22 entries move from ## docs to ## docs/adr, ## docs/reference and a new ## docs/stories at e82dba62 on 0.14.1 and read it as deletion. MEASURED by opum-doc and the leader: 22 of 22 moved commits touched docs/log.md; 202/202 entry lines identical. No defect. DELIVERABLE: one CHANGELOG line under 0.14.0 (not 0.14.1). Wording: entries for commits that also touched docs/log.md move from the shared parent section to their other paths deepest common folder; the set of entries is unchanged. Land after opum-ai/lore-cli#668 to avoid a CHANGELOG conflict; docs-only, not a release cut.
finalSummary: Delivered in the PR that carries this record (docs-only, no release cut): one sentence appended to the 0.14.0 LCLI-711 CHANGELOG entry saying entries for commits that also touched docs/log.md move from the shared parent section to their other paths deepest common folder, and that the set of entries is unchanged. Measured cause (opum-doc and the leader, opum-desktop at e82dba62): 22 of 22 moved commits touched docs/log.md, 202/202 entry lines identical; no defect. Gates run locally: lore check 0 errors, test/ci-workflow.test.ts and test/github-release.test.ts 138 pass, scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs reads the CHANGELOG without a breaking heading.
